title: Pi Coding Agent Theme
description: Theme schema for Pi coding agent

name.description: Theme name. Must not contain '/' because it is reserved for automatic light/dark theme settings.

appearance.description: Background the theme is designed for. Detected from the theme colors when omitted.

colors.description: Theme color definitions (scrollbar, thinkingMax, and search highlight colors are optional and use compatible fallbacks)

export.description: Optional colors for HTML export (defaults derived from userMessageBg if not specified)
